nodes.speaker: nell
nodes.text: The call bell rang just as I left the stage. You can check the log.

nodes.speaker: nell
nodes.text: Past the dressing room, for a costume check. And Miss Vera was inside. I thought nothing of it — until now.

nodes.speaker: nell
nodes.text: Twenty years I've run this theatre and never lost so much as a prop spoon. Find that violin, detective. Please.

nodes.speaker: otto
nodes.text: Me? Alley all night, hauling crates. Never went inside, swear it.

responses.text: And the rosin on your boots?

nodes.speaker: otto
nodes.text: Fine! I crossed the stage with crates, all right? Twenty-five crates before curtain. Snoop all you want — you'll find sweat and sawdust.

nodes.speaker: vera
nodes.text: I was in the auditorium the entire intermission, darling. Ask anyone.

responses.text: Your programme was in the foyer.

nodes.speaker: vera
nodes.text: My programme? I lose programmes the way other women lose gloves. If you found it, keep it — a souvenir of the night my violin vanished.

nodes.speaker: kit
nodes.text: Mending curtains in the workshop all intermission, sir. Me needle never stopped.

nodes.speaker: kit
nodes.text: See the hem? Twenty stitches to the inch. Miss Nell inspects every one — she'd have my hide else.
